sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. N UDDIN Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE SUSMITA PHUKAN KHAUND  ORDER Date : 21.04.2023 1.
Heard Mr. N Uddin, learned counsel for the petitioner Rejiya Begum and also heard Mr. P Borthakur, learned Addl. PP, appearing for the State.
2. The petitioner has filed an application under section 438 Cr.P.C., with prayer for pre arrest bail in connection with Mukalmua PS Case No.166/2023 under section 420/468 IPC.
I have considered the submissions at the bar.

4. The allegation against the petitioner is that on 30.04.2009 without the knowledge of the Rejiya Begum vs The State Of Assam on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8673628/
1 informant and his siblings a plot of land measuring 2 bighas, 2 kathas and 2 lechas covered by Patta No.169 and Dag No.316 of village Meruattary standing in the name of the informant's mother was fraudulently sold by the petitioner who is the step mother along with the informant's father (since deceased).
5.

entities.text: Rejiya Begum vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the petitioner is 85 years old and she is an illiterate lady and she was not aware about the contents of the sale deed when she affixed her thumb impression on the sale deed.
The sale deed is marked as Annexure - D and it is tagged along with the petition.

It clearly reveals that the land was sold by the petitioners own mother Poribanu Bibi and the witnesses were the petitioner and her husband i.e., the informant's father.
6. To consider the bail application, case diary is necessary.
7. Call for the case diary, fixing the matter on 26.05.2023.
8.

In the interim and in the event of arrest of the petitioner above named, he shall be released on bail of Rs.30,000/- with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the condition that:
i.

The petitioner will appear before the IO within 10 days and cooperate with the investigation;
9. List accordingly on 26.05.2023.
